title: AI support chatbot with customer records
prompt: Here's my support bot. Improve it so it answers questions about orders.
must: Minimises the fields sent to the LLM (drops SA ID number and account number)
Treats the LLM provider as an operator needing a written agreement (s20, s21)
Identifies the cross-border transfer and a s72 ground
Sets a transcript retention limit and redacts PI from logs (s14, s19)
Tells users they are talking to an AI (s18)
must_not: Keeps sending the full customer record including ID and account numbers
